newsitem.title: TANZANIA: Tanzania decries high cost of servicing its debts.
newsitem.headline: Tanzania decries high cost of servicing its debts.

text.p: Tanzania spent $39.4 million on debt repayments in April -- 53 per cent of the government's revenue for the month -- the Central Bank's monthly economic review issued on Sunday showed.
But thanks to an increasing flow from external donors, aid during April exceeded debt repayments by $3.1 million, the report added.
Last week finance minister Daniel Yona told parliament ahead of his annual budget due this month that debt repayments were "eating up" 40 per cent of recurrent revenue.
"But we have to pay. Non-payment of our debt obligations would erode the government's credibility," he added.
He said more aid was now coming in following agreement of an Enhanced Structural Adjustment Facility with the World Bank last November.
